text.en:
The percentage of net earnings to be declared and remitted by the
Land Bank of the Philippines and the Development Bank of the Philippines as dividends
to the National Government, as provided for Wlder Section 3 of Republic Act 7656, is
adjusted from at least fifty percent (50%) to the rates specified hereWlder:
1. Land Bank of the Philippines2.
Development of the Philippines

The adjusted dividend rates provided for under Section 1 shall only
be applicable on 1998 net earnings of the concerned government-owned
and/or controlled
corporations.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
, in the year of Our
DONE in the City of Manila, thiszAay
Lord, Nineteen Hundred and Ninety-Nine.
